content:
According to large cohort studies & meta-analyses (CDC 2022, UK Lancet Child Adolesc Health 2025, England population data):

Young males 12-29: myocarditis incidence higher after SARS-CoV-2 infection (unvaccinated) than mRNA vaccination.

- CDC: males 12-17 → 50-65 cases/100k after infection vs 22-36/100k after 2nd Pfizer dose.
- UK 2025 (85% of children): infection → +2.24 extra cases/100k over 6mo (longer-lasting); vax → +0.85/100k (short-term, first 4wk only).

Subsequent infection post-vax: risk still elevated (IRR ~6x baseline) but ~half that of pre-vax/unvax infection (IRR ~11x), per England data—likely due to milder breakthroughs.

Infection group had more cases overall.
